subject: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)

Team —

Sharing the latest copy set + QA checklist for the Week 2 console nudge experiment. Goal is to ship behind the lifecycle flag with a small ramp and clear rollback/hotfix ownership.

Proposed rollout (PT):
- Tue 1/20 10:00am: enable lifecycle_growth_console_nudges_v1 @ 10% of eligible cohorts (new signups last 14 days)
- Wed 1/21 10:00am: ramp to 50% if no P0/P1 UX issues + funnel metrics look sane
- Thu 1/22: decide 100% vs hold @ 50% based on CTR + completion and any support noise

Copy set in attachment (highlights):
1) "Create your API key" nudge
   - Title: Create an API key
   - Body: Generate a key to make your first request in minutes.
   - CTA: Create API key
2) "Make your first request" nudge
   - Title: Send a first request
   - Body: Copy a minimal snippet and confirm you get a response.
   - CTA: View example
3) "Enable streaming" nudge
   - Title: Enable streaming responses
   - Body: Faster time-to-first-token and better UX for chat.
   - CTA: Enable streaming
4) "See usage" nudge
   - Title: Track usage and latency
   - Body: Monitor tokens, latency, and errors as you iterate.
   - CTA: Open usage dashboard

QA checklist (attachment) includes: targeting rules, dismissal persistence, holdout behavior, and event emission.

Asks:
- Soojin: final messaging pass (esp. “streaming” and “usage” nudges)
- Ben: confirm measurement + success criteria for week 2 readout (CTR + completion + downstream activation)
- Camila: approve ramp plan/guardrails + escalation expectations

For hotfix/rollback ownership: I’m proposing Console oncall owns immediate rollback (flag OFF), and Product (me) owns go/no-go decisions + comms to Growth. I’ll list specific names once Dylan confirms the oncall rotation for this week.

Attaching:
- Console_Nudges_Copy_QA_v3.pdf
- Console_Nudges_QA_Checklist_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa
Product Lead, Console
Redwood Inference


---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)

Edits are small, mostly consistency + avoid claims that Legal will hate.

Suggestions:
- “Generate a key to make your first request in minutes.” → “Generate a key to make your first request.” (removes time promise)
- Streaming nudge body: “Faster time-to-first-token…” is good, but I’d tweak to: “Improve time-to-first-token and user experience for chat.”
- Usage nudge: “Track usage and latency” is on-message. I’d keep “tokens, latency, errors” (engineers like specifics).
- CTA labels: “View example” is fine, but consider “Copy example” if the destination is literally the snippet.

One more thought: titles should stay consistent style (imperative). So:
- “Send a first request” (ok)
- “Enable streaming responses” (ok)
- “Track usage and latency” (ok)

If you want a 2nd headline variant to test, the only one I’d A/B is the “first request” title:
- A: Send a first request
- B: Run a quick test request

Soojin
Messaging & Positioning


---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 10:41 AM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)

+1 to Soojin’s edits (esp removing “in minutes”).

Measurement / readout expectations for Week 2:
Primary
- Nudge CTR (by nudge type + cohort)
- Step completion rate (API key created; first request; streaming enabled; usage dashboard viewed)

Secondary / downstream
- Activation lift: % reaching first successful request within 7 days (vs holdout)
- Time-to-first-token proxy: time from signup → first successful request (median)

QA request: can you add a checklist item that validates (a) holdout assignment is stable and (b) “dismissed” state persists across sessions + doesn’t block core flows?

Re: rollout timing: Tuesday 10% is good. For the ramp, can we keep a 10% holdout (always) for 2 weeks so we don’t lose the counterfactual?

Also: if the “View example” CTA goes to docs/quickstart, we should ensure it lands on the exact snippet (min scroll). If it goes to a modal in-console, even better.

Ben
Growth / Lifecycle


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 12:16 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)

Great — I’ll incorporate.

Updates:
- Copy: removed “in minutes”; updated streaming wording per Soojin; keeping usage specifics.
- CTA: I’ll change “View example” → “Copy example” IF the destination is the snippet block; otherwise keep “View example” for consistency. I’ll confirm with the current destination behavior in the build.
- Added QA items:
  - Holdout assignment stable across sessions (user_id based)
  - Dismissal persists (local + server) and does not block any primary CTA flows

Holdout: yes, we can keep a permanent 10% holdout for the full experiment window.

Hotfix/rollback ownership (proposed, pending eng confirm):
- Immediate rollback: Console oncall flips flag OFF (lifecycle_growth_console_nudges_v1)
- Product go/no-go + comms: me
- Growth monitoring + escalation if metrics drift: Ben

Escalation paths:
- UX P0/P1: page the oncall + reply-all here + post in #lifecycle-growth-war-room
- Metrics anomalies (sudden drop or mismatch): Ben + I will coordinate with telemetry owner; rollback only if we confirm user harm

I’ll resend v4 doc once exported.

Marissa


---

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 1:07 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)

Approved on the ramp plan + guardrails.

Two conditions:
1) If any nudge is blocking a critical onboarding action (API key creation, first request), rollback immediately and notify Support lead in Slack.
2) If we see a spike in “can’t create key / can’t find key” tickets or confusion, pause the ramp at current % until resolved.

Also, please make sure the nudge dismissal behavior is accessible (keyboard + screen reader labels). It’s easy to miss until it becomes noisy.

Camila
Exec Sponsor, Growth Programs


---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 2:22 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)

All good from Growth.

For monitoring, I’ll own:
- Activation funnel dashboard checks at +2h and EOD after launch
- Daily CTR/completion check during ramp (Tue–Thu)

If anything looks off but not user-harmful (e.g., event volume mismatch), I’ll flag in #lifecycle-growth-war-room and we’ll decide whether to hold ramp vs continue.

Please include the final copy in the readout doc so we can reference exactly what shipped (helps when we compare cohorts).

Ben


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Jan 19, 2026 at 4:48 PM PT
Subject: Re: Console nudge copy + QA checklist + rollout timing (Week 2)

Finalizing with the edits now.

Launch checklist (condensed):
- Confirm flag: lifecycle_growth_console_nudges_v1
- Cohort targeting: new signups last 14 days; exclude enterprise-opportunity domains per Growth rules
- Holdout: 10% stable (user_id hash)
- Dismissal: persists across sessions; does not cover/block key creation / request submit
- Accessibility: keyboard focus order, dismiss button aria-label, no auto-focus hijack
- Eventing sanity: impressions + clicks + completion events firing once (no duplicates)
- Rollback path tested: flag OFF returns to baseline UI immediately

Rollout:
- Tue 1/20 10:00am PT @ 10%
- Wed 1/21 10:00am PT @ 50% (if green)

If we need a hotfix, I’ll post in #lifecycle-growth-war-room and tag Console oncall. If it’s user-harmful, we rollback first, then debug.

I’ll send the updated attachment (v4) once I have it exported after design tweaks.

Marissa
